status.budget_exhausted: The traffic budget is used up. Running transfers finish; nothing new starts until the period rolls over.
status.downloads_paused: Downloads are paused by the schedule until {time}. To download now anyway, switch to another profile or to “No limits” above.
status.downloads_paused_open: Downloads are paused while this profile is in force. To download now anyway, switch to another profile or to “No limits” above.

capabilities.title: What a limit cannot fully reach

notes.media_job_rate: yt-dlp takes one rate per job (--limit-rate)
notes.gallery_job_rate: gallery-dl takes one rate per job (--limit-rate)
notes.record_no_rate: streamlink has no rate limit; a live recording cannot be slowed

profile.title: Bandwidth profiles
profile.description: A profile bundles a global rate, optional per-scope rates and traffic budgets. The schedule decides when it applies.
profile.parallel_description: Caps the queue while active; empty keeps the general setting.
profile.upload_description: Applies to every upload: torrent seeding, object storage, rclone and upload destinations.
profile.delete_description: Delete the profile "{name}"? Its schedule windows go with it.
profile.pause_description: While the profile is in force no download starts, and running transfers that can resume pause until it ends. Uploads, seeding and post-processing go on; a package can be set to ignore the pause.

scope.title: Scope limits
scope.description: A narrower limit always wins over a broader one. The strictest applicable limit is shown in the status above.
scope.limit: Limit for this scope in MiB/s

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.description: Windows are local times in the timezone below, so a daylight-saving change neither skips nor repeats a period.
schedule.default_description: Profile applied when no window matches.
schedule.wraps: This window runs past midnight into the next day.
schedule.empty: No window yet — the default profile applies around the clock.
schedule.duplicate_hint: Adds a copy of the window right below it; it is stored with the schedule

manual.source_manual_open: Switched by hand, until you switch back
